what: When the top edge of a card, speech bubble, or button reaches 80% of the screen, it starts as a transparent state swollen to 1.4x and presses down with elastic.out(1.5, 3) .8s to snap at its own size — an entrance like a rubber stamp for number cards and job speech bubbles (once only)

options.rotate: Initial tilt (deg), default 0 — returns to 0° in place (brand -4)

from.where: shared.js .js-squeeze — original script.js squeeze (opacity 0 · scale 1.4 → 1, elastic.out(1.5,3) .8s, start 0% 80%)
index.js music controls ‹one-liner› speech bubble (original js-bubble: autoAlpha 0 · scale .35 · rotate -4 → 1.2s elastic.out(1.4, 0.35), when the controls’ center reaches the screen center)
from.options: scale: .35; rotate: -4; dur: 1.2; ease: elastic.out(1.4, 0.35); start: center center
